input.title: ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
input.bodyText:
ZM3D playable - brief for PlayableX
Zombie Match 3D (store name: Puzzles vs Zombies) | Prepared by Julia Lawson, 1 Oct 2025

This is the brief to build the Zombie Match 3D playable from. It describes the game as it is today. We may change the core gameplay during October; if we do, we will go through the affected parts with you in November and update this brief. What is still owed from our side, line by line, is in the hand-off list: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nBmk8LRLfmFtQmdenj3eP03vTyqRVx0JeNgroUWic-I/edit

1. Start date
Kickoff is Monday 3 November 2025, 9:00-9:30 am Pacific (the date you are holding for us). Every file we still owe is listed in the hand-off list so we can close those out before then.

2. Scenario and what it is for
We picked Scenario 1, the core gameplay. The playable is there to filter for retention: show the real game in its simplest form so the players who install are the ones who will like it, not to chase the cheapest CPI. As agreed, the player picks items freely from the pile and can make several matches if they are good enough; it is not on rails like the Domino Delights playable.

3. How a level plays
- Items sit in a 3D physics pile. The player taps or drags an item into the tray at the bottom.
- The tray has 7 slots. Three matching items in the tray clear and are fired at the zombies (by the cannon, the "rocket launcher" in your list). Different items hit differently: for example the grenade hits hard, the couch does splash damage, the plushie is weak but funny.
- Zombies walk in toward the player's base.
- Win: every zombie on screen is eliminated.
- Lose: the zombies reach us and our HP runs out.
- A full tray is not a loss. If all 7 slots fill with no match, the tray clears and the surviving zombies enrage (faster and tougher), and play carries on. The loss screen only comes at zero HP.
The reference level we built for you on 23 Sep (Brian sent the recording on 24 Sep) shows this.

4. The board: 8 items
These eight are on the board by default:
- Grenade
- Couch
- Plushie Chick (the item you called "the duck")
- Shuriken
- Cute Axe
- Gift Box
- Cactus Plant
- Bow
Bow replaces Dynamite from the earlier list. Every other board item on Brian's pack list (76 more, across Living Room, Survival, Toys, Bathroom, Kitchen, Music Instruments and Garden) is an extra you can swap in on the editable board; the hand-off list marks each one Default or Extra.
Note: Cactus Plant has new coloured pot versions since it was exported, so a fresh file is coming (see the hand-off list).

5. Zombies and animation
- Four zombies: Party Girl, Plumber, Magician, Football Player.
- One animation: walk.
All four are in the Unity package Brian sent on 26 Sep (zombies_Characters_UnityPack.zip), so you can re-rig them in Spine from that. We can add more zombies later if scope and size allow.

6. Sound and music
- Use: matching sound, success sound, failure sound. These are ours and ready.
- Rocket and explosion: the sounds in the game come from a sound library and a bought pack, so we can't hand them over. Our own versions are being made and will follow; please leave slots for them.
- Background music: a new track made for the ad (not the in-game track). It is being cut down to a loop and will follow.
- Music may only start after the player's first tap/click, per your rule from the Domino Delights playable.

7. Formats (as you gave them, still holding)
- 3D: .fbx (Binary, not ASCII), .glb or .blend
- 2D: .png (2D animation parts separated)
- Font: .ttf or .woff2
- Sound: .mp3 or .wav

8. What you already have
- First zip (24 Sep): Couch, Couch and Pillow, Grenade, Plushie Bunny, the cannon with its projectile, and the background of the reference level.
- Second zip (24 Sep): Plushie Chick.
- Zombie Unity package (26 Sep).
Everything else, and its state (Delivered / Ready / Owed), is in the hand-off list.

Contacts: Julia Lawson (brief, design), Brian Foster (files), Frederick Stone (project lead).

• Brief: https://docs.google.com/document/d/65e988f7345cfbea50e7e551/edit
• Hand-off list: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nBmk8LRLfmFtQmdenj3eP03vTyqRVx0JeNgroUWic-I/edit

Counts across Brian's 96 lines:
• *Delivered: 8* (first zip: Couch, Couch and Pillow, Grenade, Plushie Bunny, Cannon, Background; Plushie Chick in the second zip; zombie Unity pack)
• *Ready: 68*
• *Owed: 20*. Claire 9, Brian 7, Calvin 3, Martin 1.

Things that changed since Brian's notes:
• Robert swapped Bow in for Dynamite on 26 Sep, so the board is Grenade, Couch, Plushie Chick, Shuriken, Cute Axe, Gift Box, Cactus Plant, Bow.
• Cactus Plant, Chainsaw and Cone changed after Brian exported them on 25 Sep (Claire's object revisions, then the new coloured versions). So they go back to Claire. Cactus is one of the 8.
• Rocket and explosion sounds come from the Soundly library and a bought Asset Store pack, so they stay with us until Calvin makes our own versions. Calvin is also still cutting the music loop.
The 20 Owed tickets are now in Todo, each with a comment saying what's owed and who has it. I'm posting both links in the PlayableX channel next.

Hi team. Ahead of the 3 November kickoff, here is the brief for the Zombie Match 3D playable, plus the list of files still to come from us:
• Brief: https://docs.google.com/document/d/65e988f7345cfbea50e7e551/edit
• Hand-off list: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nBmk8LRLfmFtQmdenj3eP03vTyqRVx0JeNgroUWic-I/edit

In short: Scenario 1 (core gameplay) with a 7-slot tray. You win when every zombie is eliminated and lose when they reach you and HP runs out. The 8 board items are Grenade, Couch, Plushie Chick, Shuriken, Cute Axe, Gift Box, Cactus Plant and Bow. Every other board item is an extra you can swap in. For the zombies, use the walk animation on Party Girl, Plumber, Magician and Football Player. All four are in the Unity pack from 26 Sep. Music starts after the first tap, as per your rule.

The hand-off list has one row per line of the pack, each marked Delivered, Ready or Owed. For Owed rows it also says what we still owe. 20 lines are still owed, including a refreshed Cactus Plant, our own rocket and explosion sounds, the music loop, PNGs and fonts. The brief covers the game as it is today. If we change the core this month, we'll go through those parts with you in November.
